mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JOB_POSTING ( comp_id, title, field, task, exp_type, exp_year, edu, emp_type, probation, salary, address, is_remote, open_date, close_date, mgr_name, mgr_phone, mgr_email, is_public, post_status ) VALUES ( (SELECT user_id FROM user WHERE user_id = 1), #{title}, #{field}, #{task}, #{expType}, #{expYear}, #{edu}, #{empType}, #{probation}, #{salary}, #{fullAddress}, #{isRemote}, #{openDate}, #{closeDate}, #{mgrName}, #{mgrPhone}, #{mgrEmail}, #{isPublic}, 1 )
